messages:
billing-bot: ALERT: detected a mismatch between ledger ingestion and public billing dashboard for shard-7. Multiple customer accounts showing 0 tokens on the UI while backend ledger has recorded usage. Rule triggered: ui_vs_ledger_delta > 1000 tokens for 12m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0189. Severity: high. Paging sam (oncall).
sam (oncall): On it. Can someone confirm scope — is this UI-only or affecting invoice generation?
Claire (eng-sre): Initial quickcheck: ingestion pipeline good, ledger writes healthy. UI search cache (redis-shard-7) returning stale keys after a recent config change. I can repro on staging with same env flags.
Ravi (billing): Confirming invoices are not impacted yet — invoice renderer reads from ledger directly. This is display-only so far but could cause CS tickets.
Tess (cs): Heads up — two customers already pinged support about missing usage in the dashboard. They asked if they'll be charged. Need a customer-facing statement.
Mike (product): Prioritize visibility fix + customer comms. Suggest: immediate status page update + CS template that clearly says billing is accurate, dashboard values stale, working on fix.
Claire (eng-sre): Mitigation plan: 1) clear prefix cache on redis-shard-7, 2) roll UI cache service (deploy/ui-cache v2) to force cache miss and repopulate from ledger, 3) add short-term read-through bypass for critical accounts. Doing step 1 now.
Claire (eng-sre): Executed: `redis-cli -h shard-7 flushdb --prefix billing_ui_cache:*` — clearing prefix for billing keys. Observed partial recovery for 4 customers.
sam (oncall): Thanks. Please keep actions granular in the thread. Who's on the UI deploy?
Claire (eng-sre): I'm pairing with ops to kick the deploy. Will monitor token reconciliation. ETA 12m for deploy canary.
Ravi (billing): Draft for CS template (feel free to edit):
```
Hi <customer>,
We noticed a temporary issue causing the billing dashboard to show lower/zero usage for some customers. Our ledger has correctly recorded usage and invoices will reflect actual usage. We're actively rolling a fix to refresh dashboard data; you should see correct numbers within the next 2 hours. Sorry for the confusion — reach out if you need an immediate CSV export of your usage.
Best,
Redwood Billing
```
Tess (cs): LGTM. I'll hold on sending until we post a short status page entry.
Mike (product): Status page draft: "Partial dashboard visibility issue for a subset of customers in region us-west-2. Root cause: stale UI cache after config change. We are rolling a fix; ledger and billing are unaffected. Customers may see incorrect numbers in the dashboard but invoices use ledger values. Estimated time to full recovery: 2 hours."
Linda (legal): Good to clarify invoices unaffected. Also recommend we avoid saying "will not affect billing" — prefer "invoices are generated from the ledger and are expected to reflect recorded usage."
sam (oncall): Noted. Claire, please post the status page update when canary shows positive signals. Also create an internal incident summary for SLT once we have timeline.
Claire (eng-sre): Canary looks good after cache-roll, metrics: ui_vs_ledger_delta down from 1200 to 10 tokens for sampled accounts. Proceeding to full roll.
incident-bot: Note: runbook step "billing-display-stale-cache" executed by Claire at 2005002100.
Ravi (billing): CS template final (short):
```
We detected a dashboard visibility issue affecting a subset of customers. Your invoices are generated from our ledger and are expected to be correct. We're rolling a fix now; dashboard numbers should be restored within 2 hours. If you'd like an export of your usage while we reconcile, reply and we'll send it.
```
Tess (cs): Sending to affected customers list now (manually trimmed to verified accounts). I'll attach the ledger CSV for any customer requesting it.
sam (oncall): Escalation note: if any payment disputes arise, tag #legal and Ravi. Also create a reconciliation ticket linking ledger IDs -> UI account ids.
Claire (eng-sre): Created ticket: BG-7123 (reconciliation + postmortem). Assigning to eng-ui and billing infra.
Mike (product): Post-incident follow-ups: 1) add a gating test around cache invalidation in deploy pipeline, 2) improve observability to alert on ui_vs_ledger divergence earlier, 3) add a canned CS snippet in the console for immediate use.
Linda (legal): Keep me posted if any customer claims financial loss; we'll need timeline and comm history.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0189 updated: status -> mitigated. Next steps: postmortem in 48h, notify CS + product owners.
sam (oncall): Handoff to daytime owners: Claire, Ravi, Tess — please own follow-ups. I'll close paging at 2005004555 once all on-call tasks are confirmed.
Claire (eng-sre): Acknowledged. Leaving detailed notes in BG-7123 and linking metrics dashboard.
Tess (cs): Confirmed customer messages sent to 6 affected accounts; no escalations yet.
Ravi (billing): Ledger/ invoices unaffected: confirmed. We will run a bulk reconciliation job overnight for full confidence.
sam (oncall): Closing pager. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
